name: code-resonance
description: Turns your real development work into a live, private audiovisual performance: a world that grows with your code and a score that follows it. Everything runs on your machine.

commands.title: CODE RESONANCE: Open Control Center (Pairing Link)
CODE RESONANCE: Connect an AI Agent (Hooks)

resonance.receiverPort.description: Loopback port of the receiver, in the same extension host (inside WSL or the SSH host for a remote window). When nothing answers there, the receiver this extension carries starts on it.

resonance.startReceiver.description: When no receiver answers on resonance.receiverPort, start the one this extension carries: a separate process on 127.0.0.1 that every window shares and that keeps running after VS Code closes (stop it from the CR menu). A receiver already running, for example npm start in a checkout, is always used instead.

resonance.baselineFileLimit.description: Maximum workspace files indexed when recording begins.

resonance.includeHidden.description: Capture files inside dot-directories or with dot-filenames (for example .github/ or .eslintrc.js). Files matching secret exclusions are always omitted.

resonance.captureDocumentContents.description: Send bounded source snapshots to the private loopback receiver for AST analysis; never exposed by Stage API. Requires explicit Start command.

resonance.captureTerminalCommands.description: Record raw terminal command lines. Disabled by default to avoid capturing credentials. Start/end/exit events still recorded.

resonance.capturePromptText.description: Allow explicit Record AI Prompt command to include prompt text. Normally records only length and fingerprint.

resonance.shareProjectName.description: Label this project with its folder name in the local player's project list. The name is never drawn on the Stage or OBS view.
